messages:
claudia: Heads-up: quick spike in fncall schema rejections for product-search-adapter on the strict-validate route.
raj: looking at it now. rejects increased but downstream invokes still complete. feels like a jsonpath ambiguity.
kevin: can you paste the minimal payload and the rule that fired?
claudia: trace: https://traces/redwood/ghi789
payload snippet: { \"q\": \"desk chair\", \"tool_result\": { \"items\": [] }, \"items\": [] }
kevin: yup `$.items[*]` is ambiguous here and the validator matched the wrong `items`. that's why we see invalid_shape but invoke succeeded.
lucas: this causes reject_count to inflate while billing shows the invoke metric noisy chargeback alerts incoming.
tori: proposal: short-term prefer explicit fncall namespace (e.g. fncall.tool) when present. also mute the alert for 30m during the fix.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy validator v2 -> canary-1
raj: i'll cut a hotfix to prefer explicit namespaces and add a telemetry flag `parse_shadowing=true` sampled at 10% to collect matched_jsonpath + 50-char payload previews.
kevin: console change request: surface matched_jsonpath and small payload preview in validation events so triage is quicker.
lucas: will file frontend ticket and add a console filter to slice by parse_shadowing.
incident-bot: created INC-2026-045 assigned to @raj
claudia: thanks, once hotfix is stable let's add a CI linter to flag ambiguous top-level jsonpaths in new validator rules.
raj: adding that to the PR now. monitoring logs for parse_shadowing=true.
kevin: runbook: check route_tag=strict-validate billing delta, mute rule if delta > 0.5%.
